inlines.v: PET'ULANT, adjective [Latin petulans.] Saucy; pert or forward with fretfulness or sourness of temper; as a petulant youth. 1. Manifesting petulance; proceeding from pettishness; as a petulant demand; a petulant answer. 2. Wanton; freakish in passion.
